The lower crouched firing origin was repaired after the broad movement regression caught the raised muzzle.
limitations: Human mission pacing and subjective pose/difficulty review remain unverified; precise automated aim is not human input.
Android/touch hardware and performance profiling not performed.
Replay was inspected live before the last alert/contact correction and is also exercised by final passing mission tests.
